svg.title: Luck / Shards
svg.desc: Weight of each missing shard relative to each owned shard. The vertical axis is logarithmic. This is not a drop probability; probability also depends on the shard pool. Trait values use a logarithmic horizontal axis. Mastery is included in the no-direct-grants series. Each grant series adds only its named grant.
svg.text: multiplier · log scale · higher is better
